examples.text: Jana, 23, zog für ihr Studium nach Dortmund und wohnt seitdem über einem berüchtigten Club. Aggressive Partygäste inklusive.

examples.text: Blaue Hose, blaues Hemd und Schutzweste darüber, dazu festes Schuhwerk und ein Gürtel mit Taschenlampe, Handschellen, Dienstwaffe. Polizeikommissar Marvin Fregin ist bereit für die Nachtschicht an der Playa de Palma, Mallorcas berüchtigtem Party-Strand.

glosses: Having a bad reputation; disreputable; notorious; unpleasant or evil; widely known, especially for something scornful.

examples.text: He was an infamous traitor.
She is infamous for perjury.

glosses: Subject to a judicial punishment depriving (the person) of certain rights (e.g. the rights to hold public office, exercise the franchise, receive a public pension, serve on a jury, or give testimony in a court of law).

examples.text: No person shall be held to answer for a capital, or otherwise infamous crime, unless on a presentment or indictment of a Grand Jury, except in cases arising in the land or naval forces, or in the Militia, when in actual service in time of war or public danger […]
